verses.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਪਰਮ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਆਇ ਚਰਨਿ ਸਰਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jab te param gur charan saran aai charan saran liv sakal sa(n)saar hai ||

en.bdb: Since the time a human being takes the refuge in the holy feet of the True Guru, the people of the world then start contemplating in the refuge of his feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਚਰਨਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੈ ਚਾਹਿਤ ਚਰਨ ਰੇਨ ਸਕਲ ਅਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal makara(n)dh charanaamirat kai chaahit charan ren sakal akaar hai ||

en.bdb: By taking the foot-wash of the True Guru while staying in His refuge, the entire mankind desires to be blessed by his holy feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਬੀਚਾਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal sukh sa(n)paT sahaj ghar nihachal mat paramaarath beechaar hai ||

en.bdb: By living in the peaceful refuge of the lotus-like feet of the True Guru, one gets absorbed in a state of equipoise. Because of higher spiritual wisdom, they become stable of mind and consciousness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਅਗਾਧ ਬੋਧ ਨੇਤਿ ਨੇਿਤ ਨਮੋ ਨਮੋ ਕੈ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ਹੈ ॥੨੧੭॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal gur mahimaa agaadh bodh net nit namo namo kai namasakaar hai ||217||

en.bdb: The glory of the lotus-like feet of the True Guru is beyond comprehension, It is limitless, infinite. He is worthy of salutation again and again. (217)
